tells.1: Clichéd motivational phrasing like 'Never miss a session again' and 'watch your progress grow!'
tells.2: Reads like a dry summary with a plain opening and vague 'unlocks additional features'.
tells.3: Very even, templated bullet structure and the standard 'Whether you're healing...' formula.
tells.4: Vague benefit line 'unlock more of what the app has to offer' and slightly generic trust phrase 'guidance you can trust'.

reason: Version 5 reads most naturally human, but version 4 is the strongest app-store copy because it balances clarity, credibility, and warmth without becoming too casual.
